eventBlock:
push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    branches:
      - main
      - 'refactor/unified-runtime-v32-unit'
      - 'content/cognitive-expansion'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      runner_profile:
        type: choice
        options: [hosted]
        default: hosted
        description: 'Use GitHub-hosted Ubuntu for every CI job'
      step_probe:
        type: choice
        options: [none, images, cognitive, frontend, backend, backend-regression, assessment-repair, reporting, browser, media, ui, ui-chromium, qa-ui, ops, maintenance, perf]
        default: none
        description: 'Run one CI component without full CI or CodeQL'
      probe_frontend_only:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: 'Image probe: frontend only; false builds backend/worker/frontend'
      complete_training:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: 'Approved frozen Training evidence receipt; no application tests rerun'
      full_acceptance:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: 'Explicitly opt into whole-platform CI; otherwise choose a step_probe'
